---
name: Feature request
about: A new skill, template, illustration, or capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## What you want

A clear, one-sentence description of the missing thing.

## The trigger

A real situation the new skill would handle. If you don't have one, the
request is probably premature — see `skills/skill-writing/SKILL.md` for the
"a real project or incident produced the lesson" rule.

## Why existing skills don't cover it

Which existing skills did you consider, and why are they not enough? Without
this, the request is usually answered by "extend skill X."

## Sketch

Even a half-baked version helps. What would the `description:` frontmatter
look like? What 2-3 moves would the body contain?

## Source

If the new skill is a distillation of a book, link the book. If it's a
production pattern, link the production code. If it's a synthesis of existing
skills, name them.

## Out of scope

What you explicitly do NOT want this to be. This helps reviewers triage.
